name: spro-browser
description: Set up one loopback-only Playwright MCP service and persistent Chrome profile shared safely by concurrent agent clients.

interface.shortDescription: Share one persistent Playwright browser safely across agents.
interface.longDescription: Installs and manages a loopback-only Playwright MCP service backed by one persistent Chrome profile, with per-client tab ownership, a serialized authentication lease, redacted health probes, and an isolated profile canary.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up or diagnose the shared Playwright MCP service without exposing credentials or browser-profile contents.
